items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Tick, he was a little guy...

ctx.x: Yeah, Tick, he was a little guy...

Well... So they kept begging Louis. So I'm by the bandstand, sitting up by the bandstand, looking at him, observing everything. And I said, 'Give him that horn!' I gave him the horn, and it ended up Louis and the band got on this thing...got around there, and they started playing. So Louis played 'When You're Smiling,' I think. Man, he just tore up the house in pieces, boy. People screaming. Then he played another one. And he was fingering the horn and looking at the horn like it was his
